newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore, HK regulators sign cooperation pact.
newsitem.headline: Singapore, HK regulators sign cooperation pact.

text.p: Singapore's de facto central bank has signed a memorandum of understanding with Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission for the exchange of information on securities, futures and options trading.

The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) said in a statement on Thursday the agreement recognised the need for regulatory cooperation between the two bodies in view of the growing international activity in both areas.
"The memorandum aims to enhance the protection of investors and to promote the integrity of the securities and futures markets in both jurisdictions," the statement said.
